name: Lay on Hands
effectText: Your blessing can mend wounds with a touch. Touch an adjacent Character, and make a Difficulty 1 Magick + Medicine Task. On a success, the target regains 2 + Medicine [CD] HP.

name: Prayer of Healing
effectText: Your prayers can heal allies at a distance. Target a Character within Range, and make a Difficulty 1 Magick + Medicine Task. On a success, the target regains 2 + Medicine [CD] HP.

name: Salvation
effectText: Your prayers can bring salvation to you and your allies. Make a Difficulty 2 Magick + Medicine Task. On a success, yourself and all allies within Range regain 2 + Medicine [CD] HP.

name: Holy Smite
effectText: You imbue your weapon with light. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 2[CD].

name: Fearsome Smite
effectText: You imbue your weapon with awesome power. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 3[CD] and gains Daunting 1.

name: Castigate
effectText: You inspire the fear of the divine into your enemies. Target an enemy, and make a Magick + Diplomacy Task opposed by their Magick + Skirmish. On hit: 2 + Diplomacy [CD] Willpower Damage. If the target has 0 Willpower after taking this damage, they are Frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

name: Signs and Wonders
effectText: You evoke the presence of the Divine for your enemies to behold. Target any number of Characters of your choice within range: Make a Magick + Diplomacy task opposed by their Faith + Skirmish. On hit: 2 + Diplomacy [CD] Willpower Damage. If the target has 0 Willpower after taking this damage, they are Frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

name: Guiding Ray
effectText: You emit a beam of sunlight towards an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended with Awareness. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing damage, the next Attack made against the target is made with Difficulty reduced by 1, and the Hide tasks made until the end of the Target's next turn have Difficulty increased by 2.

name: Glorious Burst
effectText: You point towards a spot within range, which creates a Blast 2 explosion of sunlight. Make a Spell Attack defended with Awareness for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing damage, the next Attack made against the target is made with Difficulty reduced by 1, and the Hide tasks made until the end of the Target's next turn have Difficulty increased by 2.

name: Wrath of Heaven
effectText: Your prayers cause the Heavens to scorch the Earth, striking a spot within range, which creates a Blast 2 explosion of sunlight. Make a Spell Attack defended with Awareness for all Characters within the Area. On hit: 3[CD] Piercing damage, the next Attack made against the target is made with Difficulty reduced by 1, and the Hide tasks made until the end of the Target's next turn have Difficulty increased by 2.

name: Inquisitor's Eye
effectText: You seek out foes who are hidden from you. Make a Search task using Magick in place of Awareness (for both the Task and its range), and on a success all Characters within range are no longer hidden from you. You may remove the Invisible condition from any characters detected in this way.

name: Prayer of Fortune
effectText: Your prayer gives an ally the advantage. Make a Difficulty 1 Magick + Authority task. On a success, choose an ally within a number of spaces equal to your Magick to gain an Advantage on their first task of their next turn. On a failure, you gain 1 bonus momentum.

name: Saving Grace
effectText: When an ally within a number of spaces equal to your Magick fails a task, you can cast this spell to allow them to reroll their entire dice pool. They must keep the new result.

name: Touch of Haste
effectText: Choose an adjacent ally. They gain +4 speed until the end of their next turn.

name: Blessing of Favor
effectText: Your prayer bolsters an ally. Choose an adjacent ally and make a Difficulty 1 Magick + Authority task. On their next turn, they gain 3 bonus momentum.

name: Goodspeed
effectText: Your prayer grants you and your allies a wave of speed and skill. Make a Difficulty 2 Magick + Authority task. On a success, you and all allies within a number of spaces equal to your Magick gain +3 Speed until the end of their next turn and Advantage on the first Task made on their turn.

name: Angel's Wings
effectText: As long as you have this spell prepared, you can conjure brilliant wings of light from your back, granting you a Flying speed of Half your Magick.

name: Divine Protection
effectText: You create a protective ward around an ally. Choose a character within Range and make a Difficulty 1 Magick + Medicine task. On a success, they gain 1 + Medicine [CD] Temporary HP.

name: Shield of Faith
effectText: Your prayer grants you and your allies protection from harm. Make a Difficulty 2 Magick + Authority task. On a success, you and all allies within a number of spaces equal to your Magick gain 2 Temporary Resistance until the end of their turn.

name: Rescue
effectText: You can bring an ally to your side with a prayer. Make a Difficulty 2 Magick + Authority task. On a success, an ally that you can see within a number of spaces equal to your Magick instantly Teleports to a free space adjacent to you.

name: Aura of Life
effectText: You have an aura of life-giving energy. Characters of your choice (including yourself) heal 3 HP when they start their turn within range.

name: Aura of Victory
effectText: You have an aura of glorious battle. Characters of your choice (including yourself) deal 1[CD] extra damage whenever they would deal damage while they are within Range.

name: Aura of Courage
effectText: You have an aura of divinely inspired courage. Characters of your choice (including yourself) have an extra d20 when rolling to defend against Demoralize Tasks while they are within Range, and they regain 2 willpower when they end their turn within Range.

name: Aura of Speed
effectText: You have an aura of blessed swiftness. Characters of your choice (including yourself) gain a bonus 2 speed when they start their turn within Range.

name: Aura of Protection
effectText: You have an aura of safety from harm. Characters of your choice (including yourself) gain 1 temporary Resistance while they are within Range.
